brief: Coordinated arson in Thailand, US-Canada trade tensions, and political maneuvering dominate today's news, while robotics and AI research highlight advances in human-robot interaction and environmental monitoring.
news_summary: Dozens of arson attacks in southern Thailand raise unrest concerns; US-Canada trade war escalates with new tariffs; Artemis II crew honored; midterms heat up with tech and data center backlash.
papers_summary: Research covers UAV-based crop monitoring, AI's environmental impact, and human-robot interaction, including a study on robot voice pitch and children's stress, plus coding agent documentation behaviors.
